verdict.rationale: Langfuse's evaluation docs list 'Code Evaluators' for running deterministic checks, plus 'Scores via API/SDK' for programmatically attaching scores. Scores can be numeric, categorical, or boolean, and SDK experiments (`run_experiment`) let engineers wrap tasks and score them on datasets. That covers the core of writing custom code-based scorers. Missing for 10: detailed docs on how code evaluators are authored (function signature, aggregate/run-level metrics), and independent or hands-on corroboration of custom scorer workflows.
